title: Senior PLC & HMI Programmer/ Automation Engineer
description:
Job Description – Senior PLC & HMI Programmer

**Company:** Ecopmin Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Position:** Senior PLC & HMI Programmer  
**Number of Openings:** 20  
**Department:** Projects – Automation & Controls  
**Experience:** 7+ Years  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Reports To:** Project Manager / Automation Lead

Job Purpose

To design, develop, program, debug, and commission PLC-based automation systems and HMI applications for Special Purpose Machines (SPM) and custom-built industrial automation equipment. The candidate should independently handle automation projects from requirement analysis and programming through commissioning and customer-site support.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyse machine requirements, process flow, electrical drawings, and safety requirements.
* Develop PLC programs from scratch using Ladder Logic, Structured Text, Function Block Diagram, or other platform-supported languages.
* Design, develop, and configure HMI screens, including machine operation, alarms, diagnostics, recipes, and production monitoring.
* Implement machine sequencing, interlocks, timers, counters, fault handling, and automatic/manual operating modes.
* Configure and integrate PLCs with HMIs, VFDs, servo drives, sensors, vision systems, and other automation devices.
* Establish industrial communication using Modbus RTU/TCP, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and other relevant protocols.
* Develop and troubleshoot motion-control applications involving servo motors, stepper motors, and positioning systems.
* Implement machine safety functions in coordination with the electrical and safety teams, including emergency stops, door interlocks, and safety devices.
* Perform program simulation, offline testing, dry runs, on-machine debugging, and performance optimisation.
* Lead PLC/HMI troubleshooting during machine integration, FAT, SAT, and commissioning.
* Prepare and maintain PLC backups, I/O lists, alarm lists, functional descriptions, HMI documentation, and operating manuals.
* Coordinate with mechanical design, electrical design, assembly, and project teams to complete projects on schedule.
* Provide technical support, customer-site commissioning, and operator/service-engineer training.
* Mentor junior programmers and establish reusable programming standards and documentation practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or Automation Engineering.
* Minimum 7 years of hands-on PLC and HMI programming experience.
* Strong practical expertise in at least one major PLC platform: Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, or Delta.
* Proven ability to develop and modify PLC programs independently from scratch.
* Strong experience in HMI development, machine sequencing, interlocks, alarms, and troubleshooting.
* Experience integrating VFDs, servo drives, sensors, and industrial communication networks.
* Strong understanding of electrical drawings, PLC I/O, control-panel interfaces, and machine automation.
* Experience in machine commissioning, debugging, FAT/SAT, and customer-site support.
* Ability to independently resolve complex automation faults and deliver projects within deadlines.
* Willingness to travel for machine commissioning and customer support.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Special Purpose Machines (SPM), custom-built machines, or industrial automation projects.
* Experience in motion control, servo positioning, PID control, recipe management, and multi-axis applications.
* Knowledge of safety PLCs, safety relays, and industrial machine-safety practices.
* Experience with SCADA, vision systems, robotics, and data communication.
* Experience leading automation projects and guiding junior engineers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* On-time completion of PLC/HMI development and commissioning.
* First-time-right machine operation during FAT and SAT.
* Reduction in PLC/HMI-related machine faults and commissioning delays.
* Program quality, reusability, documentation accuracy, and backup compliance.
* Timely resolution of technical issues at the shop floor and customer sites.
* Effective coordination with project, electrical, mechanical, and service teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A senior automation professional with strong hands-on programming capability, independent project execution experience, and proven exposure to PLC/HMI development for industrial machines. Candidates with SPM or custom machine-building experience will be preferred.

**Contact Number:** 9789839956 / 9789839926 /9789839984  
**Email:** hr@ecopmin.com

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹85,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Director, Engineering
description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead the Chennai engineering organization for 2 scrum teams, shared platform resources (Architect, ML Engineer, SDET), and a team of ~20 engineers across backend, frontend, AI, and QA disciplines. You will own delivery accountability, team health, technical quality, and the cross-team coordination that keeps two scrum teams moving in the same direction. You will be the primary technical counterpart to the US-based Product leadership, the direct interface to platform teams, and the person who sets the engineering culture for the entire team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the full Chennai engineering organization (~20 engineers): two Scrum teams, two Engineering Managers, Staff/Senior engineers, Applied ML, and Staff SDET.

* Own delivery accountability: sprint cadence, cross-team dependency management, risk tracking, and executive reporting on engineering progress.

* Set and enforce technical standards: hexagonal architecture discipline, AI-native integration patterns, code quality gates, and observability standards across both teams.

* Act as the primary technical counterpart to US-based Product leadership — translate business requirements into engineering execution plans, surface trade-offs early, and maintain shared understanding of what is being built and why.

* Own the cross-team coordination interface to platform teams (Agentic Engine, Core Platform, ARC backend, Design) — ensuring product dependencies are tracked, escalated, and resolved on schedule.

* Hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent: own the full hiring pipeline, define career ladders, conduct performance reviews, and make compensation decisions.

* Drive the technical roadmap for Phase 2 in partnership with the ML Architect, Applied Scientist, and Product leadership — shaping the next wave of AI capabilities.

* Maintain technical depth: actively participate in architecture reviews, challenge design decisions, and unblock engineers on complex distributed systems and AI integration challenges.

* Build and sustain a high-trust, high-accountability engineering culture where engineers feel ownership, psychological safety, and pride in their craft.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering leadership — managing managers and leading teams of 15+ engineers.

* Deep technical background in Java backend systems, distributed microservices, and event-driven architecture — able to engage credibly in architecture reviews and design decisions.

* Proven track record building and operating SaaS platforms on AWS with multi-database stacks (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis/Aerospike).

* Demonstrated experience with hexagonal architecture at scale — enforcing domain isolation as teams and services grow.

* Strong cross-functional leadership: experience working closely with Product Management, Design, and executive stakeholders across geographies (US-India distributed teams).

* Track record of recruiting and developing senior engineering talent — building teams from the ground up in competitive markets.

* Experience delivering in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments with evolving platform dependencies and shifting priorities.

Good to Have

* Experience leading engineering teams building AI-native products (LLM integration, agentic systems, scoring pipelines, MCP tool design).

* Background in martech, customer data platforms, or dealer/automotive technology.

* Prior experience managing both backend and frontend engineering disciplines within the same org.

Exposure Temporal for durable workflow orchestration at the team level.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options.

* Medical insurance coverage.

* Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most dominant and successful companies.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in** **Ashby**

*Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!*
